messages:
lucy: dropping this here 192k mock of the latency dashboard iteration I worked on. focus: clearer p95 emphasis, sampling UX, and colorblind-friendly legend. screenshot in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC omar: quick pass 1: +1 on stronger p95 line. can we change the p95 line to a dashed heavier stroke instead of solid? easier to scan when heatmap colors are busy. maria: accessibility checklist: contrast for low-density buckets is still borderline. pattern fills + darker outlines for buckets would help. also presets need focusable states; right now keyboard users can't select the prebuilt windows. kevin: flag on axis semantics: if heatmap shows distribution and overlay is p95, the y-axis label must indicate what metric it's showing. propose: 'Latency (ms) - p95 overlay' or add a faint secondary axis ticklines for p95. anya: sampling control copy proposal: label: "Heatmap sampling". tooltip: "Percentage of matching requests included in the heatmap. Lower values reduce render cost but hide rare spikes." add a small inline help link to docs. samir: UI pattern opinion: prefer a compact segmented control with fixed options (1/5/10/25/100%) plus an "other..." that opens a numeric input for exact values. that gives reproducibility vs a free slider. lucy: agree with samir. here's mock for segmented + other modal. also added a tiny note under time-range: 'Longer windows default to higher sampling to keep heatmap legible.' thoughts? omar: suggestion: auto-bump sampling for >24h to 5% and >7d to 1% but expose the rule in the UI: 'Sampling auto-set for long range; click to override'. keeps it predictable. maria: keyboard example for segmented control: ```
...
``` ensure arrow key navigation between tabs. kevin: microcopy nits: tooltips should say 'p95 latency' and callouts should include unit 'ms'. avoid acronyms alone. also the heatmap legend needs explicit 'requests per bucket' label. lucy: colorblind mode: added diagonal hatch for low-density and dots for medium. how does everyone feel about toggling patterns via a 'Color accessibility' toggle in the legend? samir: toggle is fine but default should be patterns off for non-critical users. maybe remember preference in profile. design-bot: figma upload complete: v4.0 with segmented sampling control, p95 dashed stroke, pattern overlays, and focusable presets: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC?node-id=999 lucy: I'll update the copy strings and handoff tokens for dev tomorrow (including aria labels and the auto-sampling rules). leaving here with action items: 1) dev: implement tab/arrow nav for presets 2) dev: segmented sampling + other modal 3) docs: paragraph on sampling tradeoffs 4) ux: decide default pattern state. thanks! :party-popper:
